# Claude Warm

Claude Warm is a low-contrast theme using soft ivory in light mode and charcoal gray in dark mode, with muted red accents for links, tags, selections and focused controls. It softens sidebars, tabs, menus, modals, tables, callouts and code blocks, adds breathing room around the editor, and uses no remote fonts.

![Claude Warm screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/amm10090/claude-warm-obsidian-theme/HEAD/screenshot.png)
